desktop.notesZh: demo31 五问题批次：① 非 baf 模式新会话不再自动执行 baf-welcome（仅 baf 预设触发）。② 帮助页空白修复（help 文档同步进 web 构建）。③ 设置页「工作流」「版本与更新」标题样式与 Agent 预设统一（18px/600）；轨迹图/工作流页签 checkbox 改用开发者工具同款开关。④ bug-fix-path 流程图与 full-go-path 完全一致、仅状态显示「已裁剪」且经停直接跳过；产物文档类型与全流程统一（proposal/verify/checklist/plan/tasks，无 bug-record.md）。⑤ 流程图页顶部「可以推进工作流」推进弹窗改标准门卡语法；verify 阶段 scope_exceeded 卡滞根修（拒绝文案带 allowlist 扩展逃生路径 + verify-failed 工单 1a 规则）；demo30 bug-fix-path e2e 实测走通到归档（checklist 10/10、verify-report 机器门禁全过）。详见 .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-30-baf-demo31-five-issues.md。
desktop.notesEn: Demo31 five-issue round: (1) non-baf mode sessions no longer auto-run baf-welcome. (2) Blank help page fixed (help docs synced into the web build). (3) Settings headings for Workflow and Version & Updates now match the Agent preset (18px/600); trace-graph and workflow-tab checkboxes use the developer-tools switch. (4) bug-fix-path flow chart is now identical to full-go-path with stages shown as pruned and skipped in transit; artifact docs unified with the full flow (proposal/verify/checklist/plan/tasks, no bug-record.md). (5) advance dialogs use the standard gate-card grammar; verify-stage scope_exceeded stall root-fixed (escape-hint in rejection text + verify-failed work-order rule 1a); demo30 bug-fix-path e2e walked through to archive. See .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-30-baf-demo31-five-issues.md.
